name: Blacksmiths
description: Smelt ore and forge metal weapons, armor and tools.

name: Woodworkers
description: Saw lumber and build bows, shields, handles and town structures.

name: Tailors
description: Weave cloth and string for robes, bags and bowstrings.

name: Leatherworkers
description: Tan hides into light armor, straps and quivers.

name: Apothecaries
description: Brew potions, salves and dyes from herbs.

name: Engineers
description: Build mechanisms, siege defenses and gadgets.
